text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Shuka Sho just around 
the corner, 
wonderful news arrived!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Spectator admissions to racetracks were 
resuming...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the Director gave the official 
announcement!

Yeah, the Director gave the official 
announcement!

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to infection prevention measures, 
the domestic 
situation had begun to settle down. As a 
result, starting in October, 
spectators would be permitted back on a 
limited basis.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"So, how many people 
will be able to attend...?!"
choice_data_list: Probably fewer than a thousand, I'd say...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... 
...Of course."

On top of that, with lottery-based 
reserved seating 
and bans on loud cheering, various 
restrictions remained, 
and yet—
choice_data_list: Tact, this is a huge step forward!
Tact, this is a huge step forward!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. 
You're absolutely right...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: We'll begin anew from here—
And then, on the day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer...! 
Look, there are spectators!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Wow...!

I understood her feelings all too well. 
Having spectators back at the 
racetrack—just that alone 
brought a swell of emotion to my chest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"They've been lining up since before the 
gates opened. 
Even though today's seats are reserved..."
choice_data_list:
Even so, they just couldn't wait any 
longer.

Even so, they just couldn't wait any 
longer.

text_block_list.text:
I had heard that an overwhelming number of 
entries were submitted for the ticket 
lottery. 
And on social media, too...

text_block_list.name: Social Media Posts
text_block_list.text:
"'This Shuka Sho's gonna go down in 
history!' 
'To everyone going in person, we're 
counting on you!' 
'Made a cheering hashtag! Let's hype this 
up!'"

At this very moment, countless people 
were waiting behind screens for the gates 
to open—
choice_data_list: Even when apart, we were always connected.
Even when apart, we were always connected.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Truly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else felt the exact same way, 
wishing things could have stayed as they 
were.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It's a completely different sight from 
last year. 
Even so—the sheer magnitude of passion 
they give us 
hasn't changed in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Wait, is that... Daring Tact?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it really is...! Ah, but no 
cheering... 
Oh, r-right, on the phone...!

Held high on their screens were supportive 
words: 
"We're waiting for your Triple Tiara!"
choice_data_list: So many people are waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will answer their calls. 
Without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you slap my back? 
With all your might!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to fire myself up. 
Please, give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please!
(Thump...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
You held back... didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I know very well. 
You've grown so much stronger over this 
summer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please, with everything you've got!! 
Don't hold back!
(SMACK!!!!)
choice_data_list:
Go out there and become a Triple Tiara 
winner!

Go out there and become a Triple Tiara 
winner!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! 
—I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Really fills your chest up, doesn't it? 
Feels like things have finally—started 
moving again!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: It certainly does...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...A lot of people came today 
just to witness your Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
But you know, don't you? 
—I'm not letting you have it so easily!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
This stage is burning hotter than ever. 
What do you think happens—if I steal the 
show?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—Nobody's ever seen a cinema like that, 
right?! 
Then I'll just have to put on the 
performance of a lifetime 
right before the blazing sun!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Murmurs...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible... Win Marilyn's declaration 
has raised the crowd's expectations even 
higher...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of an actor. I couldn't 
possibly do the same, but—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...No. 
The fire that will be kindled today is 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will yield it to no one. 
The light of the Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver it straight to everyone's 
hearts!
